headline: Anthropic releases Claude Opus 4.8 for longer agentic tasks
body: A light day. Anthropic released Claude Opus 4.8, built for longer agentic coding tasks, adding a little to both Capability Velocity and AI Autonomy. That lifts endings with capable, independent AI, including Descendants, Protector God and Zookeeper. South Korea launched a plan against AI-enabled cyberattacks. Horizon Balance is 0.5, up 0.03.
